title: DATEDIFF by WEEK counts Sundays crossed: Saturday to Sunday is 1, Sunday to Saturday is 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "sat to sun", DATEDIFF ( DATE ( 2005, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2005, 1, 2 ), WEEK ), "sun to sat", DATEDIFF ( DATE ( 2005, 1, 2 ), DATE ( 2005, 1, 8 ), WEEK ) )

source.quote: With WEEK, a week starts on Sunday. For example, from a Saturday to the next Sunday the result is 1, and from a Sunday to the next Saturday the result is 0.
source.supports: the rule, with these two situations as its examples

source.quote: WEEKDAY returns the day of the week using different standards
source.supports: its example table shows 2005-01-01 is a Saturday, 2005-01-02 a Sunday and 2005-01-08 a Saturday

derivation: January 1, 2005 is a Saturday and January 2 a Sunday: one week boundary is crossed, so 1. January 2 (Sunday) to January 8 (Saturday) stays inside one week: 0.
